title: cppcheck runners never load curated .cppcheck-suppressions; syntaxError suppressed globally (spec appendix-c R-APPC-011)
description: spec/appendix-c-safety.md R-APPC-011 (cppcheck, Mandatory): run with '--error-exitcode=1 ... --suppressions-list=lichen/.cppcheck-suppressions'; 'Correctness classes (uninitvar, comparePointers, syntaxError outside known files) always fail the build.' Sweep classification: divergent. Both runners (.github/workflows/ci.yml:105-121 and scripts/lint-c.sh:44-56) pass --error-exitcode=1 and --inline-suppr but NEVER --suppressions-list=lichen/.cppcheck-suppressions, so the curated file is unwired; instead both suppress syntaxError globally on the command line, contradicting the 'syntaxError outside known files always fail' contract (the curated file confines syntaxError suppressions to 5 known macro-heavy files, lichen/.cppcheck-suppressions:13-17). Scope is lichen/subsys+lib+drivers only vs the spec command's 'lichen/' (apps/ and tests/ unscanned). Suggested placement: add --suppressions-list=lichen/.cppcheck-suppressions and drop the global --suppress=syntaxError in ci.yml and scripts/lint-c.sh; decide whether apps/tests enter scope. Full row in docs/spec-coverage.md (spec/appendix-c-safety.md sweep 2026-08-31).
